behavior.retentionPruneEndpoint: POST /api/workspaces/:organizationId/operations/retention-prune implemented with OWNER/ADMIN role authorization; non-privileged roles (EDITOR, CREATOR, ANALYST, CLIENT) rejected with 403; non-members rejected with 404
behavior.dryRunMode: Supports ?dryRun=true query parameter returning candidate counts for expiredInvitations, invalidatedPublicationIntents, canceledPublicationSchedules, and staleRenderJobs without mutating records
behavior.pruneTargets: Prunes expired invitations (expiresAt < now), orphaned invalidated/canceled publication intents with 0 child schedules/attempts, canceled publication schedules with 0 attempts, and terminal failed/canceled render jobs older than 24 hours
behavior.immutableProtection: Strictly preserves financial records (CreditEntry, CreditReservation, CreditAccount, BillingSubscription, BillingInvoice), audit trails (AuditLog), active content items, campaigns, and creative assets
behavior.auditTrail: Emits immutable retention.pruned event in AuditLog recording actorId, execution timestamp, and exact counts per pruned entity type
behavior.tests: 13 unit tests in tests/data-governance.test.ts and comprehensive HTTP integration test in tests/integration/data-export.test.ts verifying dry-run previews, role authorization, execution deletion counts, and immutable financial preservation

limits: Pruning is scoped strictly to tenant-level expired/canceled ephemeral records; financial and ledger records reject modification or deletion
Windows environment limits: full Compose verification runs on Linux CI
